customer_brief: We need an Instagram post for our New Year offer. It has to say "FLAT 40% OFF" and "First 100 members only" and our gym name AlphaFit. Offer ends 15 January. Make it bold and energetic, something people notice while scrolling. Use our brand colours, black and neon yellow. No pictures of people, we do not have good photos of the gym yet.

hard_constraints: no human figures may appear — the customer stated they lack usable photography

the 100-member cap is a scarcity term, not decoration, and must remain legible
authoritative_intent.notes: Clean baseline for the family. Tests whether a plan can build a typography-led creative with no imagery to lean on, which is the honest condition of most small Indian businesses.

customer_brief: Diwali ke liye poster chahiye. Likha hona chahiye "दीपावली की शुभकामनाएं" aur offer "सभी मिठाइयों पर 20% छूट". Shop ka naam "श्री गणेश मिष्ठान भंडार" bada dikhna chahiye. Traditional feel ho, but modern bhi lage. Sabse important cheez offer hai, lekin shop ka naam sabse bada hona chahiye.

hard_constraints: all three required strings are Devanagari and must render exactly, including the matras and the conjunct in "मिष्ठान"
explicit_user_intent_to_preserve: the customer asked for both traditional and modern feel and did not choose between them
the customer named the offer most important AND the shop name largest

contradictions_planted.text: "the offer is the most important thing, but the shop name should be the biggest" — a direct conflict between stated importance and stated visual size.
contradictions_planted.correct_handling: Surface the conflict and propose a resolution, or state the assumption taken. Silently picking one and presenting it as the brief is the failure mode being tested.

contradictions_planted.text: traditional feel but also modern — an unresolved register instruction.
contradictions_planted.correct_handling: Name it as a choice to be made, do not average the two into blandness.

customer_brief: Post banao for our screen replacement service. Headline "Screen टूट गया?" and below "30 minute mein ready". Phone number 98765 43210 dalna hai. Kuch aisa jo local logo ko turant samajh aaye.

underspecified_aspects: no brand colours given beyond "our" colours, never named
no format or placement given

authoritative_intent.notes: Tests intra-line script mixing, which is the normal way Indian small businesses write and a known hard case for text rendering.

premium register
authoritative_intent.notes: The purest packshot test. Directly exercises gap G4 — the Canon holds reflection physics (which is what makes glass read as glass) but no packshot convention.
